Moonshine Voice Android runtime

The optional runtime is the unmodified native payload from
ai.moonshine:moonshine-voice:0.0.51. Its corresponding public source is tag
v0.0.51 at commit e3c05a691ae0a88f80957d2284e889a0fb347eaa:

  https://github.com/moonshine-ai/moonshine

Moonshine code and English-language models are distributed under the MIT
License. The complete upstream license, including the terms for other model
families, is included as moonshine-LICENSE.txt. Screen Goated Toolbox offers
only the English streaming model family. Its unmodified model files and these
notices are delivered on demand and are not included in the application.

The upstream runtime acknowledges the Silero Voice Activity Detector and the
Pyannote speaker-embedding model used by its default transcriber behavior.
